description: [Personal research only] Fetch Bollinger Bands technical indicator time series with upper band, lower band, and middle line (SMA).

end_date.description: Optional end date filter in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., '2024-12-31').

max_data_points.description: Maximum number of time series data points to return.

nbdevdn.description: Number of standard deviations for lower band (typically 2)

nbdevup.description: Number of standard deviations for upper band (typically 2)

series_type.description: Price data to use for calculation.

start_date.description: Optional start date filter in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., '2024-01-01').

symbol.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., 'AAPL', 'MSFT', 'TSLA') for which to calculate Bollinger Bands

time_period.description: Number of periods for moving average calculation (typically 20)

name: fetch_bbands
